title: gfilho.net — Monitoring
description: gfilho.net on one page: status, lifecycle, uptime and alerts first, then latency and traffic, visitors and security, services, tunnel, web server, host, publishing and logs

list.name: WSL starts
list.textFormat: WSL was not running before this point: the site was offline

panels.title: Status
panels.description: Is the site reachable right now? Public site = all public pages pass from the internet (DNS → Cloudflare → tunnel → nginx); Origin = nginx answered directly. Public DOWN with Origin UP points at Cloudflare or the tunnel; both DOWN at nginx or WSL. UNKNOWN = Prometheus cannot reach the probe exporter. Response time colours follow the web.dev TTFB guidance (0.8 s / 1.8 s). p95, Availability and Monitored cover the selected range; Availability counts only the time monitoring was running, and Monitored says how much of the range that was (below 100 % = WSL or the stack was off). The probes run from this PC, so a local network fault looks like an outage: pair this with an external uptime monitor (README → Monitoring).

targets.expr: (min(probe_success{job="blackbox_origin", instance="http://127.0.0.1:8088/"} or up{job="blackbox_origin", instance="http://127.0.0.1:8088/"} * 0 + 0.5)) or on() vector(NaN)

panels.title: Lifecycle
panels.description: Time left until the TLS certificate (earliest expiry among every HTTPS address probed; Cloudflare renews it) and /.well-known/security.txt expire (renew it before 30 days: the SecurityTxtExpiringSoon alert fires then). WSL offline = time WSL was not running, from the systemd journal: the site was down then.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Every check as one status line. Green = OK, red = failing, blank = no data (WSL or the monitoring stack was not running). Public pages every 60 s, origin and staging every 30 s, 301 redirects and DNS every 5 min.

panels.title: Alerts now
panels.description: Firing and pending Prometheus alerts (monitoring/prometheus/rules.yml). There is no Alertmanager: nothing is sent anywhere, this list is the notification.

panels.title: Alert history
panels.description: When each alert was pending (amber: the condition is true but its "for" time has not passed yet) or firing (red) in the selected range, one line per alert.

targets.expr: max by (alertname, severity) (ALERTS{alertstate="firing"}) * 2 or max by (alertname, severity) (ALERTS{alertstate="pending"})

panels.title: Public response time
panels.description: Total time of each probe: the public pages through Cloudflare and the tunnel, and nginx answered directly (origin). Logarithmic axis, so both are readable; dashed line = 0.8 s (web.dev "good" TTFB). These are synthetic probes from this PC, not the latency of real visitors.

panels.title: Traffic through the tunnel
panels.description: Every request that reached the site from the internet (visitors, bots and the public probes) by HTTP status class, from cloudflared, plus requests cloudflared could not deliver to nginx (red, should stay at 0). Visitors only: the Visitors & security section below.

panels.title: Visitor traffic
panels.description: Totals for the selected range, from the production access log, without the monitoring probes, automated tools and local previews (see Request sources). Requests count every response (pages, files, errors); Page views only pages answered 200 or 304. Data served = response bodies of all visitor requests (headers excluded). These are requests, not people: unique visitors cannot be counted reliably (and are not tracked). Log pipeline = probe lines received by Loki in the last 5 minutes; when it says NO LOGS the zeros here mean nothing.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | status=~"200|304" | page =~ `^/(cases/[a-z0-9-]+/)?$` [$__range])) or vector(0)

sum(count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` [$__range])) or vector(0)

sum(sum_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | unwrap bytes | __error__="" [$__range])) or vector(0)

sum(count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" |= "\" 404 " | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | status="404" [$__range])) or vector(0)

sum(count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | status=~"5.." [$__range])) or vector(0)

((sum(count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | status=~"5.." [$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` [$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Request sources
panels.description: Every line of both access logs in exactly one group (stacked), as requests per hour: visitors, monitoring probes, automated tools (curl, scripts, headless browsers, link checkers), local previews and staging. Dashed: the total nginx counted (stub_status), which also includes the exporter's own status requests. Only "Visitors" feeds the other figures of this section.

targets.expr: sum by (source) (rate({job="nginx", log="access"} | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | label_format source=`{{ if eq .env "staging" }}Staging{{ else if contains "gfilho-monitor" .agent }}Monitoring probes{{ else if gt (__line__ | count "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit") 0 }}Automated tools{{ else if gt (count "^https?://(localhost|127[.]0[.]0[.]1)([:/].*)?$" .referer) 0 }}Local previews{{ else }}Visitors{{ end }}` [$__auto])) * 3600

panels.title: Visitor responses by status class
panels.description: Visitor requests per hour by HTTP status class (15-minute buckets). 4xx spikes are usually bots probing for files that do not exist (see Top 404s).

targets.expr: sum by (class) (rate({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | label_format class=`{{ substr 0 1 .status }}xx` [$__auto])) * 3600

panels.title: Error share
panels.description: Share of visitor requests in the previous hour that ended in 404, another 4xx or a 5xx (rolling 1-hour window). A static site should never answer 5xx; 404s are mostly scanners.

targets.expr: sum by (kind) (count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | status=~"4..|5.." | label_format kind=`{{ if eq .status "404" }}404 not found{{ else if hasPrefix "5" .status }}5xx server error{{ else }}Other 4xx{{ end }}` [1h])) / ignoring(kind) group_left sum(count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` [1h]))

panels.title: Data served
panels.description: Response-body bytes per second sent to visitors: pages, files and error pages (headers excluded), 15-minute buckets. Same scope as Requests, so it is not limited to page views.

targets.expr: sum(rate({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | unwrap bytes | __error__="" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Top pages
panels.description: The 10 most requested paths answered 200 or 304, without CSS, JS, images and technical files (query strings removed).

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (page) (count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | status=~"200|304" | page !~ `^/(assets|cdn-cgi)/.*` | page !~ `.*\.(png|ico|svg|xml|txt|webmanifest|jpg|woff2|js|css|map)$` [$__range])))

panels.title: Top 404s
panels.description: Requested paths that do not exist (query strings removed). Mostly bots looking for WordPress, .env files and similar: harmless here, none of it exists.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (page) (count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" |= "\" 404 " | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | status="404" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top referrers
panels.description: Where page views came from (links from the site itself are left out).

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (referer) (count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | status=~"200|304" | page =~ `^/(cases/[a-z0-9-]+/)?$` | referer != "-" | referer !~ `https?://(www\.)?gfilho\.net.*` [$__range])))

panels.title: Clients
panels.description: Page views by client type, a heuristic on the User-Agent with three exclusive groups. Bots & tools: declared bots, crawlers, scanners, link previews, HTTP libraries and any User-Agent with a URL in it. Browsers: looks like a real browser (scanners can fake this, so it is an upper bound for people). Unclassified: anything else.

targets.expr: sum by (client) (count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | status=~"200|304" | page =~ `^/(cases/[a-z0-9-]+/)?$` | label_format client=`{{ if gt (count "(?i)(bot|crawl|spider|slurp|scan|preview|feed|monitor|checker|validator|measurement|dataprovider|heritrix|archiver|python|go-http|wget|curl|okhttp|java/|libwww|httpx|aiohttp|axios|node-fetch|undici|^node$|headless|phantom|https?://)" .agent) 0 }}Bots & tools{{ else if gt (count "^Mozilla/5[.]0 [(](Windows|Macintosh|X11|Linux|iPhone|iPad|Android)[^)]*[)].*(Chrome|Firefox|Safari|Edg|OPR)/[0-9]" .agent) 0 }}Browsers{{ else }}Unclassified{{ end }}` [$__range]))

panels.title: Status mix
panels.description: All visitor requests in the selected range by status class (same colours as above).

targets.expr: sum by (class) (count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | label_format class=`{{ substr 0 1 .status }}xx` [$__range]))

panels.title: Unusual requests
panels.description: Visitor requests worth a look: methods other than GET and HEAD, 5xx, and 4xx other than 404 (404s are in Top 404s). The path is shown exactly as requested, query string included. Open "Logs → Unusual requests · raw lines" for the full lines.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (method, status, path) (count_over_time({job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | referer !~ `https?://(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)([:/].*)?` | label_format page=`{{ regexReplaceAll "\\?.*$" .path "" }}` | (status=~"4.." and status!="404") or status=~"5.." or method!~"GET|HEAD" [$__range])))

panels.title: Services now
panels.description: systemd state of the hosting services (RUNNING, STOPPED or FAILED; NO DATA = node-exporter is not answering), units in a failed state, times systemd restarted nginx or cloudflared after a crash (Restart=on-failure) since WSL started, and how long WSL has been running.

panels.title: Service history
panels.description: State of each hosting service over time, one cell per interval. A cell shows the worst state inside it, so a short outage between two samples is not hidden. Blank = no data.

panels.title: Tunnel now
panels.description: Active connections to the Cloudflare edge (cloudflared keeps 4; 0 = the site is unreachable), their average smoothed QUIC round-trip time, connections registered in the selected range (4 at every cloudflared start, then one per reconnect) and requests or streams cloudflared could not deliver to nginx.

panels.title: Connected data centres
panels.description: The Cloudflare data centre each of the 4 tunnel connections is attached to (named after the nearest airport: LIS = Lisbon, AMS = Amsterdam). Visitors reach the site through any of them; if one drops, the others keep it online.

panels.title: Tunnel responses by status code
panels.description: HTTP status codes nginx returned through the tunnel, in requests per hour (areas, stacked), and requests or streams cloudflared could not deliver (red lines, should stay at 0).

panels.title: Edge link
panels.description: Active tunnel connections (left axis, normal 4: dashed line) and the smoothed QUIC round-trip time of each connection (right axis, milliseconds as cloudflared reports it). Reconnections are marked by the "Tunnel registrations" annotation.

panels.title: Request rate · nginx vs tunnel
panels.description: Requests per hour counted by nginx on all its servers (production, staging, the monitoring probes and the exporter's own status requests) and by cloudflared (everything that came in from the internet). The visitor share is in the Visitors & security section.

panels.title: nginx connections
panels.description: Open client connections in nginx (stub_status): reading the request, writing the response, idle keep-alive.

panels.title: Response time by phase
panels.description: Where the time of the probe to https://gfilho.net/ goes (stacked; the total is the probe time): DNS, connect, TLS, processing (Cloudflare edge → tunnel → nginx until the first byte) and transfer.

panels.title: CPU & memory
panels.description: Busy CPU (everything but idle) and memory in use (total minus available) of the WSL VM, which the Ascender lab shares.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Used and available memory in the WSL VM (stacked: the top is the total).

panels.title: Pressure (PSI)
panels.description: Linux pressure stall information: share of time at least one task had to wait for CPU, memory or I/O. Sustained values mean the VM is short of that resource even when the usage figures look fine.

panels.title: Disk space
panels.description: Used space, computed like df. "/" is the WSL virtual disk: it reports 1 TB but grows inside a file on the Windows drive C:, so C: is the real limit. Dashed line: 90 % (DiskAlmostFull and HostDriveAlmostFull fire at 10 % free).

targets.legendFormat: C: (Windows drive holding the virtual disk)

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Traffic on the physical network interfaces (eth*); localhost, Docker and Kubernetes interfaces are left out.

panels.title: Publishing & backups
panels.description: The production web root (/var/www/html) and the snapshots that deploy.sh and install-nginx.sh keep in /var/backups/gfilho before every change (the rollback points).

panels.title: Monitoring pipeline
panels.description: Is the monitoring itself working? Scrape targets Prometheus cannot reach (their alerts cannot fire), rule evaluations that failed and log lines Alloy dropped in the selected range, and the age of the custom gfilho_* metrics (the timer runs every 2 minutes; CustomMetricsStale fires after 10).

panels.title: Maintenance
panels.description: Package updates waiting in the local APT cache (SecurityUpdatesPending fires after 3 days) and whether a reboot is needed to finish them.

panels.title: Installed versions
panels.description: Hosting components (refreshed every 2 minutes).

panels.title: nginx errors
panels.description: nginx error.log, without what scanners cause on purpose: a directory without a page ("directory index … is forbidden", answered 404) and an oversized POST ("too large body", answered 413). Both stay visible as 404 and 413 in Top 404s and Unusual requests. Missing files are no longer logged (log_not_found off since 2026-10-21); older "No such file or directory" lines are hidden too. Anything left here is a real nginx problem.

targets.expr: {job="nginx", log="error"} != "directory index of" != "client intended to send too large body" != "failed (2: No such file or directory)"

panels.title: Service warnings
panels.description: Warnings and errors from cloudflared, nginx, logrotate and the metrics timer (systemd journal).

panels.title: Recent visitor requests
panels.description: Latest visitor requests to production, without monitoring probes and automated tools.

panels.title: Unusual requests · raw lines
panels.description: The full access-log lines behind "Unusual requests".

targets.expr: {job="nginx", log="access", env="production"} !~ "gfilho-monitor|curl/|ython-urllib|HeadlessChrome|Chrome-Lighthouse|self-audit" | pattern `<_> - <_> [<_>] "<method> <path> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<referer>" "<agent>"<_>` | (status=~"4.." and status!="404") or status=~"5.." or method!~"GET|HEAD"
